PNL-QL-037.template: The marked price of an article is ₹{markedPrice}. It is sold at a discount of {discountPercent}%. Find the selling price.

PNL-QL-038.template: An article marked at ₹{markedPrice} is sold for ₹{sellingPrice}. Find the discount percentage.

PNL-QL-039.template: After allowing a discount of {discountPercent}%, a retailer sells an article for ₹{sellingPrice}. Find its marked price.

PNL-QL-040.template: An article marked at ₹{markedPrice} is offered at successive discounts of {firstDiscountPercent}% and {secondDiscountPercent}%. Find the final selling price.

PNL-QL-041.template: A retailer offers successive discounts of {firstDiscountPercent}% and {secondDiscountPercent}%. Find the single equivalent discount.

PNL-QL-042.template: An article is marked at ₹{markedPrice} and sold at a discount of {discountPercent}%. Find the discount allowed in rupees.

PNL-QL-043.template: A discount of ₹{discountAmount} is allowed on an article marked at ₹{markedPrice}. Find the discount percentage.

PNL-QL-044.template: The marked price of an article is ₹{markedPrice}. A discount of ₹{discountAmount} is allowed. Find the selling price.

PNL-QL-045.template: Two successive discounts are offered on an article. If the first discount is {knownDiscountPercent}% and the equivalent discount is {equivalentDiscountPercent}%, find the second discount.

PNL-QL-046.template: On an article marked at ₹{markedPrice}, one shop offers a single discount of {singleDiscountPercent}%, while another offers successive discounts of {firstDiscountPercent}% and {secondDiscountPercent}%. Which offer is better for the customer, and by how much?

PNL-QL-047.template: A shopkeeper marks an article {markupPercent}% above its cost price and allows a discount of {discountPercent}% on the marked price. Calculate the percentage gain or loss.

PNL-QL-048.template: An article costing ₹{costPrice} is marked {markupPercent}% above cost price and sold after allowing a discount of {discountPercent}%. Find the profit or loss incurred.

PNL-QL-049.template: An article costs ₹{costPrice} and is marked at ₹{markedPrice}. What discount should be allowed to earn a {targetRatePercent}% {targetDirection}?

PNL-QL-050.template: A trader wants to earn a {targetRatePercent}% {targetDirection} after allowing a discount of {discountPercent}%. By what percentage above cost price should the article be marked?

PNL-QL-051.template: A store offers ‘Buy {paidUnits}, get {freeUnits} free’ on identical articles. Find the equivalent discount percentage.

PNL-QL-052.template: Each article is marked at ₹{unitMarkedPrice}. Under a ‘Buy {paidUnits}, get {freeUnits} free’ offer, find the effective price per article.

PNL-QL-053.template: A customer pays ₹{billedPrice} and later receives a cashback of ₹{cashbackAmount}. Find the effective cost after cashback.

PNL-QL-054.template: A payment of ₹{billedPrice} is eligible for {cashbackPercent}% cashback. Find the effective cost after cashback.

PNL-QL-055.template: An article marked at ₹{markedPrice} is sold after a discount of {discountPercent}% and an additional coupon of ₹{couponAmount}. Find the effective price.

PNL-QL-056.template: On an article marked at ₹{markedPrice}, one seller offers a discount of {discountPercent}%, while another offers cashback of ₹{cashbackAmount}. Which offer gives the lower effective cost, and by how much?

PNL-QL-057.template: An article marked at ₹{markedPrice} is offered at successive discounts of {firstDiscountPercent}%, {secondDiscountPercent}% and {thirdDiscountPercent}%. Find the final selling price.

PNL-QL-058.template: A coupon of ₹{couponAmount} is valid only when the bill is at least ₹{minimumSpend}. If the billed amount is ₹{billedPrice}, determine whether the coupon applies and find the effective price.

PNL-QL-059.template: An article marked at ₹{markedPrice} is first discounted by {discountPercent}% and then an additional coupon of {couponPercent}% is applied to the discounted price. Find the effective price.

PNL-QL-060.template: A bill of ₹{billedPrice} earns {cashbackPercent}% cashback, subject to a maximum cashback of ₹{cashbackCap}. Find the cashback received and the effective cost.

PNL-QL-061.template: An article marked at ₹{markedPrice} is sold at a discount of {discountPercent}%. A cashback of {cashbackPercent}% of the original marked price is then offered, subject to a cap of ₹{cashbackCap}. Find the billed price, cashback and effective cost.

PNL-QL-062.template: The discount on an article is {fractionNumerator}/{fractionDenominator} of its marked price. Find the discount percentage.

PNL-QL-063.template: The ratio of the price paid to the marked price is {paidPart}:{markedPart}. Find the discount percentage.
